name: Contra Loma Plaza
summary: Contra Loma Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center in Antioch, California, managed by Phillips Edison & Company. This community-focused plaza provides convenient access to essential retail and services for East Bay residents.
demographics: Contra Loma Plaza serves a diverse, family-oriented community in Antioch, California, with a trade area characterized by middle-income households and a mix of young families and established residents. The center attracts value-conscious shoppers seeking everyday necessities and convenience-oriented retail in East Contra Costa County. The demographic profile includes a significant working-class population with household incomes ranging from $50,000 to $90,000 annually, with shopping patterns focused on grocery, pharmacy, and essential services rather than discretionary luxury spending.
description: Contra Loma Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center conveniently located at 3100 Contra Loma Boulevard in Antioch, California, serving the East Bay community with essential retail and services. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, one of the nation's leading owners and operators of grocery-anchored shopping centers, this plaza provides residents with convenient access to everyday shopping needs in a well-maintained open-air environment. The center's strategic location on Contra Loma Boulevard ensures high visibility and easy accessibility for local residents and commuters alike. With a strong focus on necessity-based retail, Contra Loma Plaza serves as a community hub where neighbors can complete their daily errands efficiently. The shopping center has earned a solid 4-star rating from over 640 Google reviews, reflecting its importance to the local community and consistent service delivery.
